entries.q.tobacco.current: Ese ubu ukoresha itabi, iryo banywa cyangwa iridanywa (nk'itabi rya sigara, shisha cyangwa iryo bahekenya)?
entries.q.auditc.1: Ni kangahe unywa ikinyobwa kirimo inzoga?
entries.q.auditc.1.opt.1: Rimwe mu kwezi cyangwa munsi yaho
entries.q.auditc.2: Ku munsi usanzwe unywaho, unywa ibinyobwa bisanzwe bingahe birimo inzoga?
entries.q.auditc.3: Ni kangahe unywa ibinyobwa 6 cyangwa birenga mu gihe kimwe?
entries.q.auditc.3.opt.4: Buri munsi cyangwa hafi buri munsi
entries.q.activity.moderate: Mu cyumweru gisanzwe, umara iminota ingahe ukora imirimo yoroheje ituma uhumeka vuba gato, nko kugenda wihuta, kwikorera imitwaro cyangwa gutwara igare?
entries.q.activity.vigorous: Mu cyumweru gisanzwe, umara iminota ingahe ukora imirimo ikomeye ituma uhumeka vuba cyane, nko kwiruka, gukina umupira cyangwa guhinga cyane?
entries.q.diet.servings: Ku munsi usanzwe, urya ibipimo bingahe by'imbuto n'imboga? Igipimo kimwe kingana n'ikiganza kimwe cyuzuye.
entries.q.diet.salt: Ese wongera umunyu ku biryo uri ku meza?
entries.q.wellness.title: Imitekerereze n'umunaniro (si itegeko)
entries.q.wellness.intro: Ibi bibazo bireba uko wiyumvise mu byumweru bibiri bishize: imitekerereze, ibitotsi, imbaraga, impungenge n'umunaniro. Si itegeko. Ushobora gusimbuka ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose, cyangwa iki gice cyose, kandi nta kindi bihindura.
entries.q.wellness.risk: Niba igisubizo kigaragaza ko ushobora kutaba umeze neza, Rinda izakwereka abantu ushobora kuvugana na bo ako kanya. Rinda ntijya ihamagara umuntu mu izina ryawe.
entries.q.wellness.separate: Ibisubizo by'imitekerereze n'umunaniro byerekanwa ukwabyo kandi ntibijya bivangwa n'ibindi bisubizo byawe.
entries.q.phq9.stem: Mu byumweru 2 bishize, ni kangahe wagize ibi bibazo bikurikira?
entries.q.phq9.1: Kutagira ubushake cyangwa ibyishimo byo gukora ibintu
entries.q.phq9.2: Kumva wacitse intege, wihebye cyangwa nta cyizere ufite
entries.q.phq9.3: Kugira ikibazo cyo gusinzira, gukanguka kenshi, cyangwa gusinzira cyane
entries.q.phq9.4: Kumva unaniwe cyangwa nta mbaraga ufite
entries.q.phq9.5: Kutagira ubushake bwo kurya cyangwa kurya cyane
entries.q.phq9.6: Kwiyumva nabi, cyangwa kumva ko watsinzwe cyangwa ko watengushye umuryango wawe
entries.q.phq9.7: Kugira ikibazo cyo kwibanda ku kintu, nko gusoma cyangwa kureba televiziyo
entries.q.phq9.8: Kugenda cyangwa kuvuga buhoro cyane ku buryo abandi babibona, cyangwa kudatuza ku buryo ugenda cyane kurusha uko bisanzwe
entries.q.phq9.9: Ibitekerezo by'uko byaba byiza upfuye, cyangwa ibyo kwigirira nabi mu buryo runaka
entries.q.gad7.stem: Mu byumweru 2 bishize, ni kangahe wagize ibi bibazo bikurikira?
entries.q.gad7.1: Kumva uhangayitse, ufite ubwoba cyangwa udatuje
entries.q.gad7.5: Kudatuza cyane ku buryo bigoye kwicara hamwe
entries.q.gad7.7: Kugira ubwoba nk'aho hari ikintu kibi kigiye kuba
